correctness.rationale: PASS: The stability function r(z)=1/(1-z+z^2/2) has coefficients (1,1,1/2,0,-1/4) through degree four. Directed four-jump entries in C_n, B_n with n>=5 are -h^4/4+O(h^5), but n<=4 cases have explicit nonnegative rational transition entries for all h. For 5-cycle only the fourth-forward numerator may be negative, with root sqrt(1+2/sqrt(5))-1; the 5-birth threshold is root of h^2(h+2)(h+6)-4. Numerator sign monotonicity proves complete n=5 positivity sets and rho_C<rho_B; spectral convergence to positive stationary projection for cycles, and Jordan asymptotic for births, prove eventual recovery for each fixed n. Independent exact symbolic inversion of C5 and B5 checked the critical entries and h=2/5 topology contrast; source checker has additional finite symbolic identities. All-n statements are based on analysis, not finite sampling.

evidence: Prior Padé theorem proves unconditional all-step positivity on acyclic digraphs of depth <=3 and the B5 threshold; no assertion on directed cyclic C5 or exact rho_C. Earlier undirected-cycle theorem starts positivity loss at C8 and has its own different root; conditional SSP literature assumes backward derivative cone conditions.
